title: Big model: the kitchen from its video, cleaned on the miniature
note: Every surface of the miniature is baked head-on from the video frames that really see it, with every frame brought to the same exposure, so fog and floaters cannot get in. What the video never saw is completed from what it did see (the floor from its own tiles), Depth Anything V2 gives the details depth, and objects that came out flat or partial are left out: nothing in the room is invented.
